attach: Ag epoxy, 25 um, z 0 to 25
Illustrative data only. Hover any wire, pad or layer for details.
One tolerance indicator, beside the die
Position ⌀50 CZ | A | B | C, on its 74 bonded pads
Data: wb:kind="tolerance" wb:char="position" wb:tol="50" wb:modifier="CZ" wb:datums="A B C"
Orange circles, 50 um across: each bonded pad's centre stays in its own
Datums: A top of substrate (section), B fiducial F1, C fiducial F2
Checked at the edges of the zone
Die moved 25 um eight ways, and turned 0.50 deg each way
Worst die edge clearance 187 um (rule 40), wire gap 141 um (rule 60)
Bonder finds the die: 1452.5 um or 17.17 deg, then W01/W02: gap 60
Bonder doesn't: 4.0 um, then W01: ball leaves its pad
